status_vocabulary.source_present: Boolean: implementation code exists in cited source tree.
status_vocabulary.compiled: Boolean: true only after successful compilation of the cited revision.
status_vocabulary.integrated: Boolean: source is connected to a kernel build target; this does not mean merged to main.
status_vocabulary.runtime_verified: Boolean: true only after runtime behavior is exercised on the exact artifact.
status_vocabulary.hardware_verified: Boolean: true only after verification on identified physical hardware.
status_vocabulary.status_fields: Adjacent *_status and evidence fields explain pending work and source evidence.
